decision: Embedding head pages when P(emergency) >= 0.86 and it leads routine by at least 0.18. Spelling head pages when P(emergency) >= 0.60 with that margin, and only when the embedding's P(other) is at least 0.10 and within 0.02 of P(routine). The spelling head can only raise. The embedding head asks when P(ask) >= 0.66, or when P(emergency) >= 0.50 and P(routine) < 0.05. Hand rules can raise the level and cannot lower it. An instruction with no described hazard stays none.
note: Synthetic split only. No QA report line and no frozen eval line was in the training rows. held_out_combined is the shipped head before hand rules raise the level. Ask recall is the embedding head alone; hand rules still ask on odd smells, pilots, and drips near power.
